exposure: shoulder dystocia in a previous delivery
previously delivering a neonate with brachial plexus birth injury
outcome: Recurrent brachial plexus birth injury in a subsequent pregnancy
cohort: All live-birth deliveries occurring in California-licensed hospitals from 1996 to 2012
finding: Parity, previous shoulder dystocia, and previously delivering a neonate with brachial plexus birth injury are associated with future brachial plexus birth injury risk.
mod_finding: Among individuals with a history of delivering a neonate with a brachial plexus birth injury, cesarean delivery was associated with a 73.0% decrease in brachial plexus birth injury risk compared with an 87.9% decrease in individuals without this history.
